title: CEO Issues Letter to Shareholders About 'Complete the Transformation' Communication Campaign
summary: PLANO, TX / ACCESS Newswire / August 6, 2026 / Intrusion Inc. (NASDAQ:INTZ) ("Intrusion" or the "Company"), a leader in AI-powered cyberattack prevention and managed cybersecurity solutions, today issued the following letter to its shareholders from its President Chief Executive Officer, Tony Scott, and its Chairman of the Board, Anthony LeVecchio. Dear Fellow Intrusion Shareholder, Cybersecurity is undergoing one of the most significant transformations in its history. Organizations today face increasingly sophisticated threats while simultaneously confronting growing complexity, limited cybersecurity talent, and rising demands to protect critical data and operations. As a result, customers are looking beyond standalone security products toward integrated platforms that combine artificial intelligence, proprietary threat intelligence, managed services, and trusted long-term partners capable of delivering measurable security outcomes.
